home.description: We support people and their teams with tools for workplace wellbeing.

about.title: One ecosystem to listen, support and act.
about.lead: SafeSpace brings together the tools people and teams need to care for workplace wellbeing in one place.
about.body: From daily mood check-ins and surveys to reports, a general-guidance chat and the HR view, everything connects to make conversations about wellbeing clearer.

employeesAndCompanies.title: One platform, two ways to support people.
employeesAndCompanies.description: SafeSpace connects everyday wellbeing with useful signals that help Human Resources listen and take action.

employees.label: For employees
employees.title: A space where you feel heard.
employees.description: Simple tools to recognize how you feel, ask for support and participate with confidence.

benefits.expression: Share how you feel without judgment.
benefits.guidance: Find general guidance when you need it.
benefits.privacy: Share reports securely and anonymously when you choose.

humanResources.label: For Human Resources
humanResources.title: Signals to support your team better.
humanResources.description: An organized view of wellbeing that helps you listen to people and turn their needs into action.

benefits.listen: Understand team trends with greater clarity.
benefits.signals: Receive useful signals without exposing individual privacy.
benefits.action: Prioritize responses and act with informed decisions.

aboutTeam.title: SafeSpace is built by people who listen too.
aboutTeam.description: Meet the team building a more human space for workplace wellbeing.
